_extraction_flags.notes: Microwave Photonics ISAC. The carrier is 60 GHz mmWave (RF), generated using optical techniques (OFC, Heterodyne). The transmission medium is RF (wireless), not Optical (FSO/VLC). It is technically 'Photonics-Assisted RF ISAC' rather than 'Optical Wireless ISAC'. Included based on user list.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: System schematic shows Laser Diodes -> Modulators -> Photodiode -> Horn Antenna (RF Radiation). Fig 2: Optical Spectra and Electrical Spectrogram (55-65 GHz). Fig 3: Eye diagram. Fig 4: Radar Range Profile (1.8cm resolution).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Photonic-based mmWave ISAC. Generation: Optical Frequency Comb (OFC) + LFM + OOK. De-chirping: Photonic mixing. Transmission: 60 GHz mmWave via Horn Antenna.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 1 Gbps OOK. Sensing: 1.8 cm resolution. Link: 1 meter +.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Novelty is the Photonic generation/processing for wideband mmWave ISAC. Allows breaking electronic bottlenecks. However, channel is RF.

bibliographic.title: 60-GHz photonic millimeter-wave joint radar-communication system
bibliographic.authors: Wenlin Bai, Xihua Zou, Peixuan Li, Wei Pan, Lianshan Yan, Bin Luo
bibliographic.venue: Unknown (Likely IEEE Conf or JLT based on style)

application.scenario_description: High-resolution radar and high-speed comms for V2X/UAVs using 60 GHz band.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Photonic generation and processing of 60 GHz LFM-OOK joint ISAC signal. Achieves 1.8cm range resolution and 1 Gbps data rate.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Electronic bandwidth limitations for generating ultra-wideband mmWave ISAC signals.

transmitter.notes: Laser (1550nm) used to generate RF. RF Bandwidth = 9 GHz (55-64 GHz).

receiver.notes: High-speed PD (70 GHz) for generation. Low-speed PD for de-chirped processing.

integration.notes: LFM (Sensing) + OOK (Comm) on same 60 GHz carrier.

waveform.notes: OOK modulated on top of LFM envelope (Inter-pulse or Integrated? Paper says 'directly modulated onto the amplitude envelop of LFMCW').

channel_wireless.notes: 1 meter wireless link (Lab setup). 60 GHz Carrier.

sensing_metrics.notes: 1.8 cm resolution verified with two targets.
